headline: Notes, and to-dos that start agents
summary: diri 0.9.0 adds Notes: plans and to-do lists that sit next to your agents, where any to-do can start an agent with the note as its brief.

items.title: Notes
items.text: Think next to your agents. Type / for blocks and @ to link a session; every note is plain Markdown on disk.
items.alt: A blank note becomes a launch plan: a title, a to-do from the slash menu, and an @ mention that links a running Claude Code session.

items.title: To-dos that start agents
items.text: Press ⌃⌘↩ on a to-do to hand it to an agent with the note as context. Its progress shows up right under the to-do.
items.alt: A to-do opens the Start panel, becomes a Claude Code session in the sidebar, asks a question, and finishes ready to review.

items.title: Search every note
items.text: ⇧⌘F finds a note by anything it says, not just its title.
items.alt: Typing pricing in Search notes finds three notes by what they say.
